Foxgloves outside the window, warm sunrise beams, tactile brass and wood, crisp realistic detail, balanced composition. A single enamel sign reads exactly LOCAL IMAGINATION. No people, no watermark, no extra text.

A cosy English garden studio with an open window on the left, blooming foxgloves and leafy plants outside, early morning sunlight, an aged plaster wall and a solid wooden desk. Keep the room believable, tactile and uncluttered.

# Krea 2 Structured Prompt

This is the same Krea 2 generation path as workflow 01, but the first node builds a structured prompt.

- Start in **1. Structured Prompt Builder**.
- Read the generated text before changing downstream settings.
- Keep the sampler unchanged while learning what each prompt field contributes.
- Then compare this result with the manual-prompt version using the same seed.
